# synology_afp (Resource)

AFP file-sharing configuration. Destroy releases management without disabling the service.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `apply_default_permissions` (Boolean) Apply DSM default UNIX permissions.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable AFP.
- `quick_disconnect` (Boolean) Disconnect idle clients quickly.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton identity and import identifier: afp. Destroy only releases Terraform management; it never resets DSM settings.
